about: Hebrews shows that Jesus is greater than everything, and reminds us of people who trusted God.

pages.title: Heroes of Faith
pages.scene: A line of heroes: Noah, Abraham, Moses and others
pages.text: Faith means trusting God even when we can't see. Noah built the ark by faith. Abraham left home by faith. Moses led the people by faith. Sarah, Rahab, David and many others trusted God too.
pages.lesson: Trust God, even when you can't see.

pages.title: Run the Race
pages.scene: Children running a race with people cheering
pages.text: "We have so many faith heroes cheering us on! Let's run our race and not give up. Let's keep our eyes on Jesus." God loves us like a good father loves his children.
pages.lesson: Keep your eyes on Jesus and don't give up.
